title: Maximising the economic value of renewable and battery storage hybrids with revenue stacking
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00776G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mathis Landy, Oliver Schmidt, Nathan Johnson, Iain Staffell
Renewable-storage hybrids are increasingly attractive, but there is no universal best design. We optimise UK revenue-stacking and arbitrage in 30 countries, showing where and why co-location, full hybrids and stand-alone batteries create most value.
